# Shruti 1.4.34
- A damaged settings file can no longer cost you your licence or restart your 14-day trial. Shruti keeps a copy of the last good settings, rebuilds from it (or from whatever can still be read), keeps the damaged file aside, and tells you what happened. - MIDI controllers: when two controls move at the same moment, every message is now read correctly. Changing MIDI mappings while a controller is moving can no longer cause a crash. Bypass All and Scene buttons fire once per press instead of repeating while a knob or fader is held high. - Cleaner audio path: the live audio callback no longer allocates memory, and removing or swapping an Audio Unit plug-in no longer makes the audio wait while the plug-in shuts down. - The app and the audio service can no longer overwrite each other's saved settings. - The control socket refuses to start, instead of overflowing, if a home folder path is unusually long. - Importing from SoundSource, and `shruti output volume`, no longer crash on a malformed number. - The command-line installer and the audio-driver scripts now refuse to run while REAPER, Logic, MainStage, Zoom or OBS is open, so a class or recording is never cut.
Requires macOS 14.2 or later; Apple silicon and Intel. Existing settings, app arrangements and window preferences are retained.
